messages:
Aisha (Growth): Hey team :wave: Quick design request for the webinar + benchmark push next week. Need a small asset set for socials, the blog, and the webcast landing. Priority: benchmark micro-tiles, a one-pager diagram for the webinar slide pack, and two hero variants for the benchmark post (static + small loop). Can someone take lead on production and brand check? Deadline: EOD Wed (72 hrs).

Tom (Design): I can take this. Quick q: sizes and formats? also want the final headline copy + any approved photography/illustrations. Will build as Figma components so PMs can swap copy.

Renee (Product Marketing): Headline for benchmark hero: "2–4x inference throughput, 40% lower token cost". Subhead: "Redwood Inference: production economics for LLM serving." CTAs: primary = "Read the benchmark" (UTM below), secondary = "Join the webinar". For micro-tiles, short stat-first variants: "2–4x throughput", "40% lower cost", "<10ms median tail latency". Keep copy short.

Oliver (Brand): Brand quick list: use Redwood Gradient v2, primary font = InterVariable, accent = #0066FF, and lockup rules: do not crop logo, keep 32px clear space. Avoid heavy photo backgrounds on stat tiles — use semi-opaque panel over image or flat color. I can review final exports.

Tom (Design): Great — I'll create: 3 micro-tile sizes (square 1080x1080, story 1080x1920, carousel 1200x628), one A4 printable one-pager (210x297mm @300dpi) and a slide-ready 1920x1080 diagram. Export specs I'll use:```
export_format: PNG
scale: 2
colorspace: sRGB
trim: false
background: transparent for hero, flattened for tiles
```Also will make an animated 3s loop for the hero as MP4 H.264, 1080p baseline. Sharing Figma link in a sec.

Renee (Product Marketing): For CTAs/UTM — primary campaign params: utm_source=org_marketing&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_q2. For webinar routing: add utm_content=webinar_signup. Destination form = /webinars/benchmark-q2 -> leads go to Salesforce queue "Benchmark Webinars". Jordan, can you confirm routing?

Jordan (Ops): Confirmed. Form will post to SFDC queue "Benchmark Webinars" and ping #sales-inbound. Use `source: marketing_benchmark_q2` in the payload. I'll add a Zapier test in staging.

design-bot: Brand lint scan: Figma file contains one instance of deprecated logo lockup and dark background on stat-tile frame. Flagged for Oliver review.

Oliver (Brand): on it, will post exact replacements in the Figma comments. Also request: add alt-text suggestions to each export for accessibility.

Tom (Design): noted. I'll update frames and include alt-text in the export package. ETA for first drafts: 36 hours. Will drop a Figma file + a zipped export with naming convention: `benchmark_<asset>_<size>_v1.png`.

Aisha (Growth): Amazing, thanks. Please tag me when drafts are in Figma. If design-bot clears brand lint and Jordan confirms routing, we can schedule the blog + social publish for Thu. :white_check_mark:

Renee (Product Marketing): Also need 2 caption variations for each micro-tile (short + long). I'll paste them in comments in the Figma frames.

Tom (Design): Perfect — I'll push frames and ping here. :eyes:

Aisha (Growth): Thanks everyone — small ask but big impact. :rocket:
